scientific.integrity: The source q-FedAvg numerator and denominator are specialized directly to two deterministic equal-curvature scalar quadratics. At nonzero client losses, the source smoothness upper bound becomes the exact transformed-loss Hessian, giving an exact Newton identity.
limitations: Two equally weighted symmetric scalar quadratic clients.
Deterministic full participation and exactly one local gradient step of size 1/a.
The deadbeat statement uses the open interval between client minimizers and does not define the raw source formula at zero client loss for 0<q<1.
No claim for stochastic local gradients, unequal curvatures, multiple local steps, client subsampling, or vector-valued noncommuting Hessians.
The result is an optimization-dynamics statement, not a claim that \(q=1/2\) is statistically optimal for fairness.

title: q-FedAvg has a unique deadbeat fairness exponent on symmetric quadratics
